fire: The seminar on ethics spent two weeks reading Martin Buber.
Visitors to the museum lined up to see the work of Marcel Duchamp.
Our history teacher assigned a short biography of Martin Luther.
The mime artist Marcel Marceau toured the world for decades.
In the novel class we discussed a book by Martin Amis.
The church is dedicated to San Martín de Porres.
French cinema owes a great deal to the director Marcel Carné.
The physicist Martin Rees wrote about the future of humanity.

The mime artist Charlie Chaplin toured the world for decades.
In the novel class we discussed a book by Zadie Smith.
The church is dedicated to Saint Francis of Assisi.
French cinema owes a great deal to the director Jean Renoir.
The physicist Richard Feynman wrote about the joy of discovery.
